Young Guns Events · Working brief

Design preferences overview

Sumbal Chak farmhouse, Lahore. Sunday 8 November. Afternoon nikkah for 40 guests, evening mehndi for about 200. Two outdoor zones on the same property. Nikkah and mehndi looks are specified separately below.

Sumbal Chak · Lahore 8 November Two outdoor zones @younggunsevents Updated: 28 Aug 2026

Day flow

Part 1

Nikkah

Own outdoor podium on the farmhouse lawn. About 40 guests. White + wood garden ceremony. Open to the garden and sky — no fabric canopy.

40 guests Afternoon White + wood No canopy Flower necklaces + pastel smoke Light speaker music

Nikkah references

Chairs and aisle

  • Wooden cross-back chairs, dark stain, tan / beige cushion.
  • Sheer white drape, tied at the side, with one greenery sprig.
  • About 40 chairs plus 2–4 spare. Short rows either side of a petal aisle.
  • Low white floral mounds along the chair line (Nikkah 03). Height lives in the arch, not in the aisle.
  • White petals on the grass. No built carpet runner.

Partition / arch

  • White floral arch at the front of the aisle, same white + greenery as the chairs.
  • Center drop: hanging strands of white blooms as a soft barrier.
  • During the ceremony the drop is the partition: he on one side, she on the other. Guests can still see both.
  • Behind the arch: a two-seat sofa, plus one chair on each side of the sofa.
  • Tall white arrangements on stands flanking the arch. White welcome board to one side.
  • Toward the end, the arch comes down so the couple can stand together on that stage for necklaces + smoke.
  • Do not swap in a gold frame, fabric mandap, or the pink tunnel from the smoke clip.

Flower necklaces and smoke

  • Toward the end of the nikkah, the floral arch / hanging drop comes down.
  • The couple then stand together on the nikkah stage (not split by the drop).
  • That is when they exchange flower necklaces — after the ceremony is finishing, on the open stage.
  • Smoke fires on that necklace exchange, same beat.
  • Pastel rainbow if the vendor has it (lilac, mint, blush, peach, soft gold). If not, use the standard colors rather than skip it.
  • Crew watches the couple and hits the cue when the first flower necklace goes on.

Nikkah music

  • Khadija chooses the nikkah music.
  • Young Guns Events provides the speaker setup so that playlist can play. Not a DJ set.
  • Keep it under the ceremony — no show that competes with the vows or the necklace exchange.

No canopy

  • No fabric tent, sail, or canopy over the nikkah seats.
  • The ceremony sits in the open garden: nature, sky, and the farmhouse garden as the backdrop.
  • There may be some trees on the property. They are part of the garden view, not a roof over the rows.
  • Date is 8 November at Sumbal Chak. Historical chance of measurable rain in Lahore that day is about 2% — among the driest days of the year (lowest is ~2% on 7 November; November wet-day chance stays around 3%).
  • Typical range that day: about 16–28°C (61–82°F). Condensation is an early-morning wipe on metal or glass, not a reason to roof the ceremony.
  • Keep a simple rain backup off to the side if needed. Do not dress the nikkah under fabric “just in case.”

Part 2

Mehndi

Separate outdoor zone on the same farmhouse. About 200 guests. Built from 8–10 AM. Festive lounge + stage + dance floor. Color can follow the references or whatever Young Guns Events proposes in the same register.

200 guests Evening Own zone Cane lounge Arched stage Dance floor fabric overhead Decorative carts Gol guppa + paan stalls DJ still to book No weather canopy

Mehndi stage and dance floor references

Stage

  • Long sofa on the stage, beige / sand — not the pink sofa in the clips.
  • Colorful flower bank immediately behind the sofa.
  • Framed backdrop: mint / aqua scalloped arches, not plain pipe-and-drape.
  • From those arches, hanging ropes, marigold-style garlands, or fabric panels drop down.
  • Gold peacock, pink chandeliers, and hanging baskets are optional.

Dance floor and overhead

  • Defined dance floor in front of the stage.
  • Overhead on the dance floor only: decorative fabric strips radiating up into a high arch / blob, with hanging florals or baskets if it fits.
  • That fabric is décor only. It is not a weather canopy and should not be built as rain cover.
  • Pink patterned floor wrap is fine, or another finish Young Guns prefers.
  • Color: this pink / mint / marigold scheme is acceptable, or Young Guns Events can propose the final palette in the same festive register.

Mehndi: no weather canopy

  • Same rule as nikkah: do not put a tent or rain canopy over the mehndi stage, lounge, or dance floor.
  • Venue: Sumbal Chak farmhouse, Lahore. Date: 8 November.
  • On 8 November in Lahore, the historical chance of measurable rain (more than about 1 mm) is about 2%.
  • That is the low point of the year — 7 November is also ~2%, and a typical November day stays around 3%. July, by contrast, is about 51%.
  • Typical temperatures that day: roughly 16°C at night to 28°C in the afternoon. Cool evening, not a monsoon risk.
  • A rain backup can live off to the side if Young Guns wants one. It should not become the mehndi ceiling.

Why this is locked

  • Both outdoor looks — nikkah lawn and mehndi zone — stay open to the garden and sky.
  • Decorative dance-floor fabric (if used) is a visual, not weather protection.
  • Do not add a canopy “just in case” for 8 November at Sumbal Chak.

Mehndi lounge references

Lounge furniture

  • Sofa — want. Wood + cane frame, white cushions, styled with mustard / lime / pink pillows.
  • Table — want this vintage table. Round wood, cane lower shelf, ribbed glass top. Coffee-table height for lounge clusters.
  • Chairs — not compulsory, but we want them. Matching wood + cane barrel lounge chairs. If they cannot be sourced, sofa + vintage table still define the look.
  • Group as conversation pockets on a patterned rug if available.
  • The snakes-and-ladders cube table is not required. Console styling and printed menus in the refs are optional.

Nikkah chairs at mehndi

  • Mehndi seating does not depend on the nikkah chairs.
  • After nikkah photos, some ceremony chairs may move over and sit around the vintage tables as extras.
  • That move is optional and new for us — do not strip the nikkah lawn before photos are done.
  • If chairs move, leave the white drapes on.

Mehndi cart references

Decorative carts

  • Two or three carts on the mehndi grounds. Lean toward the wooden style if we add more.
  • Dress them with flowers, hanging garlands, plates, and a mehndi display (cones, bowls, color) so they read as mehndi carts.
  • Purely decorative. Guests should not sit here to get mehndi applied. Do not staff them as working mehndi stations.
  • Plates can stay on the cart as styling. Mehndi can be on the cart as décor — not for use.

Food stalls — separate

  • Apart from the decorative carts, we want real stalls for gol guppa and paan.
  • Those two are working food stalls. Guests use them.
  • Do not combine the gol guppa / paan service onto the decorative wooden carts.

Mehndi music

  • A DJ for the mehndi. Should be on site by the time the evening starts.
  • DJ is not booked yet — still to arrange / confirm with Young Guns Events.

Food during the changeover

  • After the short nikkah, the couple change in the farmhouse rooms for mehndi.
  • Guests get chai and easy finger food in that gap: small sandwiches and samosas.
  • Confirm with Young Guns Events where that station sits on the farmhouse.
